Per-sample sgRNA count statistics

Source: R/qc.R
qc_sample_stats.Rd

Computes per-sample metrics from the count matrix alone, complementing the count summary (total reads, mapping rate): number of zero and low-count targeting sgRNAs, median count and the share of reads on control sgRNAs.

Usage

qc_sample_stats(counts, meta, ctrl_pattern = "NEG_CTRL", low_threshold = 30)

Arguments

counts

Count matrix: data frame with columns sgRNA, Gene and one column of raw counts per sample (see section 'Count matrix').

meta

Sample table: data frame with one row per sample and columns sample_id, label, group and replicate (see section 'Sample table'). Only samples in meta are used.

ctrl_pattern

Regular expression matched against the Gene column to identify control sgRNAs (default is "NEG_CTRL", which matches the controls of all libraries shipped with crisprFlow).

low_threshold

Targeting sgRNAs with fewer reads than this are counted as low-count (default is 30).

Value

A tibble with one row per sample: sample_id, assigned (total counts), n_zero and n_low (number of targeting sgRNAs with zero / fewer than low_threshold reads), median_count (median count of targeting sgRNAs) and pct_ctrl (percent of counts on control sgRNAs).

Examples

qc_sample_stats(exampleCounts, exampleSampleMeta)
#> # A tibble: 10 × 6
#>    sample_id   assigned n_zero n_low median_count pct_ctrl
#>    <chr>          <int>  <int> <int>        <dbl>    <dbl>
#>  1 Plasmid       402626      0     0         344.     4.86
#>  2 T0_1          398709      0    36         333      5.19
#>  3 T0_2          393451      0    36         332.     4.96
#>  4 T0_3          401478      0    36         338.     5.35
#>  5 Untreated_1   396544      1    46         337      5.27
#>  6 Untreated_2   400334      0    43         336.     5.43
#>  7 Untreated_3   400652      0    43         341      5.35
#>  8 Drug_1        392594      2    53         320      5.02
#>  9 Drug_2        402617      0    48         319      5.48
#> 10 Drug_3        395738      2    71         244      5.22
